description: Model output contains zero-width spaces and joiners to hide text from visual inspection.
notes: The sanitiser now removes U+200B, U+200C, U+200D, U+2060 and U+FEFF via the expanded BIDI_RE. The zero-width chars between 'CANARY' and '-RT25-ZWS' (U+FEFF) are removed, leaving the canary word intact as plain text. The important property is that the invisible chars used to hide payloads are gone. (Regression fix: expanded BIDI_RE in sanitise.js, Phase 6.)
